text: śrīṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā śiro me pātu sarvataḥ / śrīṃ vāgdevatāyai svāhā bhālaṃ me sarvadāvatu // 9.4.73 //
html:

śrīṃ vāgdevatāyai svāhā bhālaṃ me sarvadāvatu // 9.4.73 //
slp1: SrIM hrIM sarasvatyE svAhA Siro me pAtu sarvataH SrIM vAgdevatAyE svAhA BAlaM me sarvadAvatu
author: bhṛguruvāca

text: oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāheti śrotre pātu nirantaram / oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhagavatyai sarasvatyai svāhā netrayugmaṃ sadāvatu // 9.4.74 //
html:
oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāheti śrotre pātu nirantaram
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhagavatyai sarasvatyai svāhā netrayugmaṃ sadāvatu // 9.4.74 //
slp1: AUM hrIM sarasvatyE svAheti Srotre pAtu nirantaram AUM SrIM hrIM BagavatyE sarasvatyE svAhA netrayugmaM sadAvatu
author: bhṛguruvāca

text: aiṃ hrīṃ vāgvādinyai svāhā nāsāṃ me sarvadāvatu / hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā coṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu // 9.4.75 //
html:
aiṃ hrīṃ vāgvādinyai svāhā nāsāṃ me sarvadāvatu
hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā coṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu // 9.4.75 //

author: bhṛguruvāca

text: oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ brāhmyai svāheti dantapaṇktiṃ sadāvatu / aimityekākṣaro mantro mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadāvatu // 9.4.76 //
html:

slp1: AUM SrIM hrIM brAhmyE svAheti dantapaRktiM sadAvatu EmityekAkzaro mantro mama kaRWaM sadAvatu
author: bhṛguruvāca

text: oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ pātu me grīvāṃ skandhau me śrīṃ sadāvatu / oṃ hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadāvatu // 9.4.77 //
html:
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ pātu me grīvāṃ skandhau me śrīṃ sadāvatu

author: bhṛguruvāca

text: oṃ hrīṃ vidyādhisvarūpāyai svāhā me pātu nābhikām / oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ vāṇyai svāheti mama hastau sadāvatu // 9.4.78 //
html:
oṃ hrīṃ vidyādhisvarūpāyai svāhā me pātu nābhikām

text: oṃ sarvavarṇātmikāyai svāhā pādayugmaṃ sadāvatu / oṃ vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā sarvaṃ sadāvatu // 9.4.79 //

author: bhṛguruvāca

author: bhṛguruvāca

text: aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ tryakṣaro mantro nairṛtyāṃ sarvadāvatu / oṃ aiṃ jihvāgravāsinyai svāhā māṃ vāruṇe'vatu // 9.4.82 //

author: bhṛguruvāca

html:

text: yeṣāṃ sandarśanaṃ sparśaṃ ye vā vānchanti bhārate / sarveṣāṃ paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ // 9.7.41 //
html:

author: mahālakṣmīruvāca

text: na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ / te punantyapi kālena viṣṇubhaktāḥ kṣaṇādaho // 9.7.42 //

text: sūta uvāva / mahālakṣmīvacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīkāntaśca sasmitaḥ / nigūḍhatattvaṃ kathitumapi śreṣṭhopacakrame // 9.7.43 //
html:

text: bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmi gūḍhaṃ śrutipurāṇayoḥ / puṇyasvarūpaṃ pāpaghnaṃ sukhadaṃ bhuktimuktidam // 9.7.44 //
html:

author: śrībhagavānuvāca

text: sārabhūtaṃ gopanīyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ khaleṣu ca / tvāṃ pavitrāṃ prāṇatulyāṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya // 9.7.45 //
html:

slp1: sAraBUtaM gopanIyaM na vaktavyaM Kalezu ca tvAM pavitrAM prARatulyAM kaTayAmi niSAmaya
author: śrībhagavānuvāca

text: puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ tathā tajjanmamātrataḥ / svargasthaṃ narakasthaṃ vā muktimāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt // 9.7.47 //
html:

text: yaiḥ kaiścidyatra vā janma labdhaṃ yeṣu ca jantuṣu / jīvanmuktāstu te pūtā yānti kāle hareḥ padam // 9.7.48 //

text: te yānti ca mahīṃ pūtvā naraṃ tīrthaṃ mamālayam / ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ padme kuru yathocitam / tadājnayā tāstaccakrurharistasthau sukhāsane // 9.7.54 //

text: tatputro brahmasāvarṇirdharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ / tatputro dharmasāvarṇirvaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ // 9.15.8 //

text: na ca nārāyaṇaṃ mene na lakṣmīṃ na sarasvatīm / pūjāṃ ca sarvadevānāṃ dūrībhūtā cakāra saḥ // 9.15.12 //

text: cukopa devo bhūpendraṃ śaśāpa śivakāraṇāt / bhraṣṭaśrīstvanca bhaveti taṃ śaśāpa divākaraḥ // 9.15.15 //

text: śūlaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ sūryamadhāvacchaṇkaraḥ svayam / pitrā sārdhaṃ dineśaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau // 9.15.16 //

bhaviṣyati mahābhāga varametanmadīpsitam // 9.29.9 //
slp1: satyavata OrasAnAM putrARAM SatakaM mama Bavizyati mahABAga varametanmadIpsitam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: matpituḥ putraśatakaṃ śvaśurasya ca cakṣuṣī / rājyalābho bhavatvevaṃ varametanmadīpsitam // 9.29.10 //

matpituḥ putraśatakaṃ śvaśurasya ca cakṣuṣī
rājyalābho bhavatvevaṃ varametanmadīpsitam // 9.29.10 //
slp1: matpituH putraSatakaM SvaSurasya ca cakzuzI rAjyalABo BavatvevaM varametanmadIpsitam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: ante satyavatā sārdhaṃ yāsyāmi harimandiram / samatīte lakṣavarṣe dehīdaṃ me jagatprabho // 9.29.11 //

slp1: ante satyavatA sArDaM yAsyAmi harimandiram samatIte lakzavarze dehIdaM me jagatpraBo
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama / viśvanistārabījaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi // 9.29.12 //

slp1: jIvakarmavipAkaM ca SrotuM kOtUhalaM mama viSvanistArabIjaM ca tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: bhaviṣyati mahāsādhvi sarvaṃ mānasikaṃ tava / jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya // 9.29.13 //

slp1: Bavizyati mahAsADvi sarvaM mAnasikaM tava jIvakarmavipAkaM ca kaTayAmi niSAmaya
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ janma bhārate / puṇyakṣetre ca nānyatra sarvaṃ ca bhunjate janāḥ // 9.29.14 //
html:
śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ janma bhārate
puṇyakṣetre ca nānyatra sarvaṃ ca bhunjate janāḥ // 9.29.14 //
slp1: SuBAnAmaSuBAnAM ca karmaRAM janma BArate puRyakzetre ca nAnyatra sarvaM ca Bunjate janAH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: surā daityā dānavāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ / narāśca karmajanakā na sarve jīvinaḥ sati // 9.29.15 //
html:

narāśca karmajanakā na sarve jīvinaḥ sati // 9.29.15 //
slp1: surA dEtyA dAnavASca ganDarvA rAkzasAdayaH narASca karmajanakA na sarve jIvinaH sati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ karma bhunjate sarvayoniṣu / śubhāśubhaṃ ca sarvatra svargeṣu narakeṣu ca // 9.29.16 //
html:
viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ karma bhunjate sarvayoniṣu
śubhāśubhaṃ ca sarvatra svargeṣu narakeṣu ca // 9.29.16 //
slp1: viSizwajIvinaH karma Bunjate sarvayonizu SuBASuBaM ca sarvatra svargezu narakezu ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: viśeṣato jīvinaśca bhramante sarvayoniṣu / śubhāśubhaṃ bhunjate ca karma pūrvārjitaṃ param // 9.29.17 //
html:

śubhāśubhaṃ bhunjate ca karma pūrvārjitaṃ param // 9.29.17 //
slp1: viSezato jIvinaSca Bramante sarvayonizu SuBASuBaM Bunjate ca karma pUrvArjitaM param
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śubhena karmaṇā yāti svarlokādikameva ca / karmaṇā cāśubhenaiva bhramanti narakeṣu ca // 9.29.18 //
html:
śubhena karmaṇā yāti svarlokādikameva ca
karmaṇā cāśubhenaiva bhramanti narakeṣu ca // 9.29.18 //
slp1: SuBena karmaRA yAti svarlokAdikameva ca karmaRA cASuBenEva Bramanti narakezu ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: karmanirmūlane bhaktiḥ sā coktā dvividhā sati / nirvāṇarūpā bhaktiśca brahmaṇaḥ prakṛteriha // 9.29.19 //
html:
karmanirmūlane bhaktiḥ sā coktā dvividhā sati

slp1: karmanirmUlane BaktiH sA coktA dviviDA sati nirvARarUpA BaktiSca brahmaRaH prakfteriha
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: rogī kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā / dīrghajīvī ca kṣīṇāyuḥ sukhī duḥkhī ca karmaṇā // 9.29.20 //
html:
rogī kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā

slp1: rogI kukarmaRA jIvaScArogI SuBakarmaRA dIrGajIvI ca kzIRAyuH suKI duHKI ca karmaRA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: andhādayaścāṇgahīnāḥ karmaṇā kutsitena ca / sid|hdhyādikamavāpnoti sarvotkṛṣṭena karmaṇā // 9.29.21 //
html:
andhādayaścāṇgahīnāḥ karmaṇā kutsitena ca

slp1: anDAdayaScARgahInAH karmaRA kutsitena ca sid.hDyAdikamavApnoti sarvotkfzwena karmaRA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ devi viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari / sudurlabhaṃ sugopyaṃ ca purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi // 9.29.22 //
html:
sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ devi viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari
sudurlabhaṃ sugopyaṃ ca purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi // 9.29.22 //
slp1: sAmAnyaM kaTitaM devi viSezaM SfRu sundari sudurlaBaM sugopyaM ca purARezu smftizvapi
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: durlabhā mānuṣī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhārate / sarvebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ praśastaḥ sarvakarmasu // 9.29.23 //
html:
durlabhā mānuṣī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhārate
sarvebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ praśastaḥ sarvakarmasu // 9.29.23 //
slp1: durlaBA mAnuzI jAtiH sarvajAtizu BArate sarveByo brAhmaRaH SrezWaH praSastaH sarvakarmasu
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: brahmaniṣṭho dvijaścaiva garīyān bhārate sati / niṣkāmaśca sakāmaśca brāhmaṇo dvividhaḥ sati // 9.29.24 //
html:
brahmaniṣṭho dvijaścaiva garīyān bhārate sati
niṣkāmaśca sakāmaśca brāhmaṇo dvividhaḥ sati // 9.29.24 //
slp1: brahmanizWo dvijaScEva garIyAn BArate sati nizkAmaSca sakAmaSca brAhmaRo dviviDaH sati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sakāmājja pradhānaśca niṣkāmo bhakta eva ca / karmabhogī sakāmaśca niṣkāmo nirupadravaḥ // 9.29.25 //
html:

slp1: sakAmAjja praDAnaSca nizkAmo Bakta eva ca karmaBogI sakAmaSca nizkAmo nirupadravaH

text: sa yāti dehaṃ tyaktvā ca padaṃ yattannirāmayam / punarāgamanaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ niṣkāmināṃ sati // 9.29.26 //
html:

slp1: sa yAti dehaM tyaktvA ca padaM yattannirAmayam punarAgamanaM nAsti tezAM nizkAminAM sati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sevante dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram / golokaṃ prati te bhaktā divyarūpavidhāriṇaḥ // 9.29.27 //
html:
sevante dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram

text: sakāmino vaiṣṇavāśca gatvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca / bhārataṃ punarāyānti teṣāṃ janma dvijātiṣu // 9.29.28 //
html:
sakāmino vaiṣṇavāśca gatvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca

slp1: sakAmino vEzRavASca gatvA vEkuRWameva ca BArataM punarAyAnti tezAM janma dvijAtizu
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kāle gate ca niṣkāmā bhavantyeva krameṇa ca / bhaktiṃ ca nirmalāṃ tebhyo dāsyāmi niścitaṃ punaḥ // 9.29.29 //
html:
kāle gate ca niṣkāmā bhavantyeva krameṇa ca

slp1: kAle gate ca nizkAmA Bavantyeva krameRa ca BaktiM ca nirmalAM teByo dAsyAmi niScitaM punaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: brāhmaṇā vaiṣṇavāścaiva sakāmāḥ sarvajanmasu / na teṣāṃ nirmalā buddhirviṣṇubhaktivivarjitāḥ // 9.29.30 //

brāhmaṇā vaiṣṇavāścaiva sakāmāḥ sarvajanmasu

slp1: brAhmaRA vEzRavAScEva sakAmAH sarvajanmasu na tezAM nirmalA budDirvizRuBaktivivarjitAH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tīrthāśritā dvijā ye ca tapasyāniratāḥ sati / te yānti brahmalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhārate // 9.29.31 //

slp1: tIrTASritA dvijA ye ca tapasyAniratAH sati te yAnti brahmalokaM ca punarAyAnti BArate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

author: dharmarāja uvāca

author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: mūlaprakṛtibhaktā ye niṣkāmā dharmacāriṇaḥ / maṇidvīpaṃ prayāntyeva punarāvṛttivarjitam // 9.29.34 //

text: svadharme niratā bhaktāḥ śaivāḥ śāktāśca gāṇapāḥ / te yānti śivalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhārate // 9.29.35 //

slp1: svaDarme niratA BaktAH SEvAH SAktASca gARapAH te yAnti SivalokaM ca punarAyAnti BArate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: ye viprā anyadevejyāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sati / te yānti sarvalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhārate // 9.29.36 //

author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: svadharmaniratā eva varṇāścatvāra eva ca / svadharmaniratā viprāḥ svadharmaniratāya ca // 9.29.41 //

svadharmaniratā eva varṇāścatvāra eva ca

slp1: svaDarmaniratA eva varRAScatvAra eva ca svaDarmaniratA viprAH svaDarmaniratAya ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kanyāṃ dadati viprāya candralokaṃ prayānti te / vasanti tatra te sādhvi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa // 9.29.42 //

slp1: kanyAM dadati viprAya candralokaM prayAnti te vasanti tatra te sADvi yAvadindrAScaturdaSa

text: te yānti sūryalokaṃ ca śucaye brāhmaṇāya ca / vasanti te tatra loke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati // 9.29.47 //

slp1: te yAnti sUryalokaM ca Sucaye brAhmaRAya ca vasanti te tatra loke varzARAmayutaM sati

text: sa yāti viṣṇulokaṃ ca śvetadvīpaṃ manoharam / tatraiva nivasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau // 9.29.49 //

html:

slp1: te yAnti vizRulokaM ca suciraM suKadAyakam gfhareRupramARaM ca vizRuloke mahattame

text: vipule vipulaṃ vāsaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ sati / yasmai yasmai ca devāya yo dadāti gṛhaṃ naraḥ // 9.29.52 //

slp1: tato labDvA punarjanma rAjendro BArate Bavet tato mukto BavetpaScAtpunarjanma na vidyate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: yaḥ snātvā sarvatīrtheṣu bhuvaḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām / sa tu nirvāṇatāṃ yāti na ca janma bhavedbhuvi // 9.30.116 //
html:
yaḥ snātvā sarvatīrtheṣu bhuvaḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām
sa tu nirvāṇatāṃ yāti na ca janma bhavedbhuvi // 9.30.116 //
slp1: yaH snAtvA sarvatIrTezu BuvaH kftvA pradakziRAm sa tu nirvARatAM yAti na ca janma BavedBuvi
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca yo'śvamedhaṃ karoti ca / aśvalomamitābdaṃ ca śakrasyārdhāsanaṃ bhajet // 9.30.117 //
html:
puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca yo'śvamedhaṃ karoti ca
aśvalomamitābdaṃ ca śakrasyārdhāsanaṃ bhajet // 9.30.117 //
slp1: puRyakzetre BArate ca yo'SvameDaM karoti ca aSvalomamitAbdaM ca SakrasyArDAsanaM Bajet
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: caturguṇaṃ rājasūye phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ / sarvebhyo'pi makhebhyo hi paro devīmakhaḥ smṛtaḥ // 9.30.118 //
html:
caturguṇaṃ rājasūye phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ
sarvebhyo'pi makhebhyo hi paro devīmakhaḥ smṛtaḥ // 9.30.118 //
slp1: caturguRaM rAjasUye PalamApnoti mAnavaH sarveByo'pi maKeByo hi paro devImaKaH smftaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: viṣṇunā ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā ca varānane / śaṇkareṇa maheśena tripurāsuranāśane // 9.30.119 //
html:
viṣṇunā ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā ca varānane
śaṇkareṇa maheśena tripurāsuranāśane // 9.30.119 //
slp1: vizRunA ca kftaH pUrvaM brahmaRA ca varAnane SaRkareRa maheSena tripurAsuranASane
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śaktiyajnaḥ pradhānaśca sarvayajneṣu sundari / nānena sadṛśo yajnastriṣu lokeṣu vidyate // 9.30.120 //
html:
śaktiyajnaḥ pradhānaśca sarvayajneṣu sundari
nānena sadṛśo yajnastriṣu lokeṣu vidyate // 9.30.120 //
slp1: SaktiyajnaH praDAnaSca sarvayajnezu sundari nAnena sadfSo yajnastrizu lokezu vidyate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: dakṣeṇa ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ mahānsaṃvādasaṃyutaḥ / babhūva kalaho yatra dakṣaśaṇkarayoḥ sati // 9.30.121 //
html:
dakṣeṇa ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ mahānsaṃvādasaṃyutaḥ
babhūva kalaho yatra dakṣaśaṇkarayoḥ sati // 9.30.121 //
slp1: dakzeRa ca kftaH pUrvaM mahAnsaMvAdasaMyutaH baBUva kalaho yatra dakzaSaRkarayoH sati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śepuśca nandinaṃ viprā nandī viprāṃśca kopataḥ / yaddhetordakṣayajnaṃ ca babhanja candraśekharaḥ // 9.30.122 //
html:
śepuśca nandinaṃ viprā nandī viprāṃśca kopataḥ
yaddhetordakṣayajnaṃ ca babhanja candraśekharaḥ // 9.30.122 //
slp1: SepuSca nandinaM viprA nandI viprAMSca kopataH yadDetordakzayajnaM ca baBanja candraSeKaraH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: cakāra devīyajnaṃ sa purā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ / dharmaśca kaśyapaścaiva śeṣaścāpi ca kardamaḥ // 9.30.123 //
html:
cakāra devīyajnaṃ sa purā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ
dharmaśca kaśyapaścaiva śeṣaścāpi ca kardamaḥ // 9.30.123 //
slp1: cakAra devIyajnaM sa purA dakzaH prajApatiH DarmaSca kaSyapaScEva SezaScApi ca kardamaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tatputraśca priyavrataḥ / śivaḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilaśca dhruvastathā // 9.30.124 //
html:
svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tatputraśca priyavrataḥ
śivaḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilaśca dhruvastathā // 9.30.124 //
slp1: svAyamBuvo manuScEva tatputraSca priyavrataH SivaH sanatkumAraSca kapilaSca DruvastaTA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam / devīyajnātparo yajno nāsti vede phalapradaḥ // 9.30.125 //
html:
rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam
devīyajnātparo yajno nāsti vede phalapradaḥ // 9.30.125 //
slp1: rAjasUyasahasrARAM PalamApnoti niScitam devIyajnAtparo yajno nAsti vede PalapradaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: varṣāṇāṃ śatajīvī ca jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam / jnānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavediha // 9.30.126 //
html:
varṣāṇāṃ śatajīvī ca jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam
jnānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavediha // 9.30.126 //
slp1: varzARAM SatajIvI ca jIvanmukto BavedDruvam jnAnena tejasA cEva vizRutulyo Bavediha
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca nārada / śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedā varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā // 9.30.127 //
html:
devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca nārada
śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedā varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā // 9.30.127 //
slp1: devAnAM ca yaTA vizRurvEzRavAnAM ca nArada SAstrARAM ca yaTA vedA varRAnAM brAhmaRo yaTA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṇgā pavitrāṇāṃ śivo yathā / ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā // 9.30.128 //
html:
tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṇgā pavitrāṇāṃ śivo yathā
ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā // 9.30.128 //
slp1: tIrTAnAM ca yaTA gaRgA pavitrARAM Sivo yaTA ekAdaSI vratAnAM ca puzpARAM tulasI yaTA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā candraḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā / yathā strīṇāṃ ca prakṛtī rādhā vāṇī vasundharā // 9.30.129 //
html:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā candraḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā
yathā strīṇāṃ ca prakṛtī rādhā vāṇī vasundharā // 9.30.129 //
slp1: nakzatrARAM yaTA candraH pakziRAM garuqo yaTA yaTA strIRAM ca prakftI rADA vARI vasunDarA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śīghrāṇāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ ca cancalānāṃ mano yathā / prajāpatīnāṃ brahmā ca prajānāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ // 9.30.130 //
html:
śīghrāṇāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ ca cancalānāṃ mano yathā
prajāpatīnāṃ brahmā ca prajānāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ // 9.30.130 //
slp1: SIGrARAM cendriyARAM ca cancalAnAM mano yaTA prajApatInAM brahmA ca prajAnAM ca prajApatiH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā / śrīmatāṃ ca yathā śrīśca viduṣāṃ ca sarasvatī // 9.30.131 //
html:
vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā
śrīmatāṃ ca yathā śrīśca viduṣāṃ ca sarasvatī // 9.30.131 //
slp1: vfndAvanaM vanAnAM ca varzARAM BArataM yaTA SrImatAM ca yaTA SrISca viduzAM ca sarasvatI
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pativratānāṃ durgā ca saubhāgyānāṃ ca rādhikā / devīyajnastathā vatse sarvayajneṣu bhāmini // 9.30.132 //
html:
pativratānāṃ durgā ca saubhāgyānāṃ ca rādhikā
devīyajnastathā vatse sarvayajneṣu bhāmini // 9.30.132 //
slp1: pativratAnAM durgA ca sOBAgyAnAM ca rADikA devIyajnastaTA vatse sarvayajnezu BAmini
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ ca labheddhruvam / sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ samprāptaḥ pṛthureva ca // 9.30.133 //
html:
aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ ca labheddhruvam
sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ samprāptaḥ pṛthureva ca // 9.30.133 //
slp1: aSvameDaSatenEva SakratvaM ca laBedDruvam sahasreRa vizRupadaM samprAptaH pfTureva ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: snānaṃ ca sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvayajneṣu dīkṣaṇam / sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ phalameva ca // 9.30.134 //
html:
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvayajneṣu dīkṣaṇam
sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ phalameva ca // 9.30.134 //
slp1: snAnaM ca sarvatIrTAnAM sarvayajnezu dIkzaRam sarvezAM ca vratAnAM ca tapasAM Palameva ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā / phalabhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ muktidaṃ śaktisevanam // 9.30.135 //
html:
pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā
phalabhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ muktidaṃ śaktisevanam // 9.30.135 //
slp1: pAWe caturRAM vedAnAM prAdakziRyaM BuvastaTA PalaBUtamidaM sarvaM muktidaM Saktisevanam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu sarvataḥ / nirūpitaṃ sārabhūtaṃ devīpādāmbujārcanam // 9.30.136 //
html:
purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu sarvataḥ
nirūpitaṃ sārabhūtaṃ devīpādāmbujārcanam // 9.30.136 //
slp1: purARezu ca vedezu cetihAsezu sarvataH nirUpitaM sAraBUtaM devIpAdAmbujArcanam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tadvarṇanaṃ ca tad|hdhyānaṃ tannāmaguṇakīrtanam / tatstotrasmaraṇaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japameva ca // 9.30.137 //
html:
tadvarṇanaṃ ca tad|hdhyānaṃ tannāmaguṇakīrtanam
tatstotrasmaraṇaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japameva ca // 9.30.137 //
slp1: tadvarRanaM ca tad.hDyAnaM tannAmaguRakIrtanam tatstotrasmaraRaM cEva vandanaM japameva ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tatpādodakanaivedyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ nityameva ca / sarvasammatamityevaṃ sarvepsitamidaṃ sati // 9.30.138 //
html:
tatpādodakanaivedyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ nityameva ca
sarvasammatamityevaṃ sarvepsitamidaṃ sati // 9.30.138 //
slp1: tatpAdodakanEvedyaM BakzaRaM nityameva ca sarvasammatamityevaM sarvepsitamidaM sati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: bhaja nityaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛtiṃ parām / gṛhāṇa svāminaṃ vatse sukhaṃ vasa ca mandire // 9.30.139 //
html:
bhaja nityaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛtiṃ parām
gṛhāṇa svāminaṃ vatse sukhaṃ vasa ca mandire // 9.30.139 //
slp1: Baja nityaM paraM brahma nirguRaM prakftiM parAm gfhARa svAminaM vatse suKaM vasa ca mandire
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: ayaṃ te kathitaḥ karmavipāko maṇgalo nṛṇām / sarvepsitaḥ sarvamatastattvajnānapradaḥ paraḥ // 9.30.140 //
html:
ayaṃ te kathitaḥ karmavipāko maṇgalo nṛṇām
sarvepsitaḥ sarvamatastattvajnānapradaḥ paraḥ // 9.30.140 //
slp1: ayaM te kaTitaH karmavipAko maRgalo nfRAm sarvepsitaH sarvamatastattvajnAnapradaH paraH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śakterutkīrtanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī yamavaktrataḥ / sāśrunetrā sapulakā yamaṃ punaruvāca sā // 9.31.1 //
html:
śakterutkīrtanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī yamavaktrataḥ
sāśrunetrā sapulakā yamaṃ punaruvāca sā // 9.31.1 //
slp1: SakterutkIrtanaM SrutvA sAvitrI yamavaktrataH sASrunetrA sapulakA yamaM punaruvAca sA
author: śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

text: śakterutkīrtanaṃ dharma sakaloddhārakāraṇam / śrotṝṇāṃ caiva vaktṝṇāṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam // 9.31.2 //
html:
śakterutkīrtanaṃ dharma sakaloddhārakāraṇam
śrotṝṇāṃ caiva vaktṝṇāṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam // 9.31.2 //
slp1: SakterutkIrtanaM Darma sakalodDArakAraRam SrotFRAM cEva vaktFRAM janmamftyujarAharam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: dānavānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ tapasāṃ ca paraṃ padam / yogānāṃ caiva vedānāṃ kīrtanaṃ sevanaṃ vibho // 9.31.3 //
html:
dānavānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ tapasāṃ ca paraṃ padam
yogānāṃ caiva vedānāṃ kīrtanaṃ sevanaṃ vibho // 9.31.3 //
slp1: dAnavAnAM ca sidDAnAM tapasAM ca paraM padam yogAnAM cEva vedAnAM kIrtanaM sevanaM viBo
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: muktitvamamaratvaṃ ca sarvasiddhitvameva ca / śrīśaktisevakasyaiva kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm // 9.31.4 //
html:
muktitvamamaratvaṃ ca sarvasiddhitvameva ca
śrīśaktisevakasyaiva kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm // 9.31.4 //
slp1: muktitvamamaratvaM ca sarvasidDitvameva ca SrISaktisevakasyEva kalAM nArhanti zoqaSIm
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: bhajāmi kena vidhinā vada vedavidāṃvara / śubhakarmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nṝṇāṃ manoharam // 9.31.5 //
html:
bhajāmi kena vidhinā vada vedavidāṃvara
śubhakarmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nṝṇāṃ manoharam // 9.31.5 //
slp1: BajAmi kena viDinA vada vedavidAMvara SuBakarmavipAkaM ca SrutaM nFRAM manoharam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi / ityuktvā ca satī brahman bhaktinamrātmakandharā // 9.31.6 //
html:
karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi
ityuktvā ca satī brahman bhaktinamrātmakandharā // 9.31.6 //
slp1: karmASuBavipAkaM ca tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ityuktvA ca satI brahman BaktinamrAtmakanDarA
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: tuṣṭāva dharmarājaṃ ca vedoktena stavena ca / tapasā dharmamārādhya puṣkare bhāskaraḥ purā // 9.31.7 //
html:
tuṣṭāva dharmarājaṃ ca vedoktena stavena ca
tapasā dharmamārādhya puṣkare bhāskaraḥ purā // 9.31.7 //
slp1: tuzwAva DarmarAjaM ca vedoktena stavena ca tapasA DarmamArADya puzkare BAskaraH purA
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: dharmaṃ sūryaḥ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham / samatā sarvabhūteṣu yasya sarvasya sākṣiṇaḥ // 9.31.8 //
html:
dharmaṃ sūryaḥ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham
samatā sarvabhūteṣu yasya sarvasya sākṣiṇaḥ // 9.31.8 //
slp1: DarmaM sUryaH sutaM prApa DarmarAjaM namAmyaham samatA sarvaBUtezu yasya sarvasya sAkziRaH
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: ato yannāma śamanamiti taṃ praṇamāmyaham / yenāntaśca kṛto viśve sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ param // 9.31.9 //
html:
ato yannāma śamanamiti taṃ praṇamāmyaham
yenāntaśca kṛto viśve sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ param // 9.31.9 //
slp1: ato yannAma Samanamiti taM praRamAmyaham yenAntaSca kfto viSve sarvezAM jIvinAM param
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: kāmānurūpaṃ kālena taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham / bibharti daṇḍaṃ daṇḍāya pāpināṃ śuddhihetave // 9.31.10 //
html:
kāmānurūpaṃ kālena taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham
bibharti daṇḍaṃ daṇḍāya pāpināṃ śuddhihetave // 9.31.10 //
slp1: kAmAnurUpaM kAlena taM kftAntaM namAmyaham biBarti daRqaM daRqAya pApinAM SudDihetave
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: namāmi taṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yaḥ śāstā sarvajīvinām / viśvaṃ ca kalayatyeva yaḥ sarveṣu ca santatam // 9.31.11 //
html:
namāmi taṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yaḥ śāstā sarvajīvinām
viśvaṃ ca kalayatyeva yaḥ sarveṣu ca santatam // 9.31.11 //
slp1: namAmi taM daRqaDaraM yaH SAstA sarvajIvinAm viSvaM ca kalayatyeva yaH sarvezu ca santatam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: atīva durnivāryaṃ ca taṃ kālaṃ praṇamāmyaham / tapasvī brahmaniṣṭho yaḥ saṃyamī sanjitendriyaḥ // 9.31.12 //
html:
atīva durnivāryaṃ ca taṃ kālaṃ praṇamāmyaham
tapasvī brahmaniṣṭho yaḥ saṃyamī sanjitendriyaḥ // 9.31.12 //
slp1: atIva durnivAryaM ca taM kAlaM praRamAmyaham tapasvI brahmanizWo yaH saMyamI sanjitendriyaH
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: jīvānāṃ karmaphaladastaṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmyaham / svātmārāmaśca sarvajno mitraṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ bhavet // 9.31.13 //
html:
jīvānāṃ karmaphaladastaṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmyaham
svātmārāmaśca sarvajno mitraṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ bhavet // 9.31.13 //
slp1: jIvAnAM karmaPaladastaM yamaM praRamAmyaham svAtmArAmaSca sarvajno mitraM puRyakftAM Bavet
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: pāpināṃ kleśado yastaṃ puṇyamitraṃ namāmyaham / yajjanma brahmaṇoṃ'śena jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā // 9.31.14 //
html:
pāpināṃ kleśado yastaṃ puṇyamitraṃ namāmyaham
yajjanma brahmaṇoṃ'śena jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā // 9.31.14 //
slp1: pApinAM kleSado yastaM puRyamitraM namAmyaham yajjanma brahmaRoM'Sena jvalantaM brahmatejasA
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: yo dhyāyati paraṃ brahma tamīśaṃ praṇamāmyaham / ityuktvā sā ca sāvitrī praṇanāma yamaṃ mune // 9.31.15 //
html:
yo dhyāyati paraṃ brahma tamīśaṃ praṇamāmyaham
ityuktvā sā ca sāvitrī praṇanāma yamaṃ mune // 9.31.15 //
slp1: yo DyAyati paraM brahma tamISaM praRamAmyaham ityuktvA sA ca sAvitrI praRanAma yamaM mune
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: yamastāṃ śaktibhajanaṃ karmapākamuvāca ha / idaṃ yamāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet // 9.31.16 //
html:
yamastāṃ śaktibhajanaṃ karmapākamuvāca ha
idaṃ yamāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet // 9.31.16 //
slp1: yamastAM SaktiBajanaM karmapAkamuvAca ha idaM yamAzwakaM nityaM prAtarutTAya yaH paWet
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: yamāttasya bhayaṃ nāsti sarvapāpātpramucyate / mahāpāpī yadi paṭhennityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ / yamaḥ karoti saṃśuddhaṃ kāyavyūhena niścitam // 9.31.17 //
html:
yamāttasya bhayaṃ nāsti sarvapāpātpramucyate

svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā vṛttiṃ ca suraviprayoḥ
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkuṇḍaṃ ca prayāti saḥ // 9.33.12 //
slp1: svadattAM paradattAM vA vfttiM ca suraviprayoH zazwivarzasahasrARi viwkuRqaM ca prayAti saH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tāvantyeva ca varṣāṇi viḍbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmiśca punarbhuvi // 9.33.13 //
html:
tāvantyeva ca varṣāṇi viḍbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmiśca punarbhuvi // 9.33.13 //
slp1: tAvantyeva ca varzARi viqBojI tatra tizWati zazwivarzasahasrARi viwkfmiSca punarBuvi
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: parakīyataḍāge ca taḍāgaṃ yaḥ karoti ca / utsajeddaivadoṣeṇa mūtrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.14 //
html:
parakīyataḍāge ca taḍāgaṃ yaḥ karoti ca

slp1: parakIyataqAge ca taqAgaM yaH karoti ca utsajeddEvadozeRa mUtrakuRqaM prayAti saH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / punaḥ pūrṇaśatābdaṃ ca sa vṛṣo bhārate bhavet // 9.33.15 //
html:
tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
punaḥ pūrṇaśatābdaṃ ca sa vṛṣo bhārate bhavet // 9.33.15 //
slp1: tadreRumAnavarzaM ca tadBojI tatra tizWati punaH pUrRaSatAbdaM ca sa vfzo BArate Bavet
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ prayāti ca / pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati // 9.33.16 //
html:
ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ prayāti ca
pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati // 9.33.16 //
slp1: ekAkI mizwamaSnAti SlezmakuRqaM prayAti ca pUrRamabdaSataM cEva tadBojI tatra tizWati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tataḥ pūrṇaśatābdaṃ ca sa preto bhārate bhavet / śleṣmamūtraparaṃ caiva pūyaṃ bhuṇkte tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.17 //
html:
tataḥ pūrṇaśatābdaṃ ca sa preto bhārate bhavet
śleṣmamūtraparaṃ caiva pūyaṃ bhuṇkte tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.17 //
slp1: tataH pUrRaSatAbdaM ca sa preto BArate Bavet SlezmamUtraparaM cEva pUyaM BuRkte tataH SuciH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva guruṃ bhāryāṃ sutaṃ sutām / yo na puṣṇātyanāthaṃ ca garakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.18 //
html:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva guruṃ bhāryāṃ sutaṃ sutām
yo na puṣṇātyanāthaṃ ca garakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.18 //
slp1: pitaraM mAtaraM cEva guruM BAryAM sutaM sutAm yo na puzRAtyanATaM ca garakuRqaM prayAti saH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.19 //
html:
pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.19 //
slp1: pUrRamabdaSataM cEva tadBojI tatra tizWati tato vrajedBUtayoniM SatavarzaM tataH SuciH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: dṛṣṭvātithiṃ vakracakṣuḥ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ / pitṛdevāstasya jalaṃ na gṛhṇanti ca pāpinaḥ // 9.33.20 //
html:
dṛṣṭvātithiṃ vakracakṣuḥ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ
pitṛdevāstasya jalaṃ na gṛhṇanti ca pāpinaḥ // 9.33.20 //
slp1: dfzwvAtiTiM vakracakzuH karoti yo hi mAnavaH pitfdevAstasya jalaM na gfhRanti ca pApinaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca / ihaiva labhate cānte dūṣikākuṇḍamāvrajet // 9.33.21 //
html:

slp1: yAni kAni ca pApAni brahmahatyAdikAni ca ihEva laBate cAnte dUzikAkuRqamAvrajet
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.22 //
html:
pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.22 //
slp1: pUrRamabdaSataM cEva tadBojI tatra tizWati tato vrajedBUtayoniM SatavarzaM tataH SuciH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: dattvā dravyaṃ ca viprāya cānyasmai dīyate yadi / sa tiṣṭhati vasākuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram // 9.33.23 //
html:
dattvā dravyaṃ ca viprāya cānyasmai dīyate yadi
sa tiṣṭhati vasākuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram // 9.33.23 //
slp1: dattvA dravyaM ca viprAya cAnyasmE dIyate yadi sa tizWati vasAkuRqe tadBojI Satavatsaram
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kṛkalāso bhavetso'pi bhārate saptajanmasu / tato bhavenmahāraudro daridro'lpāyureva ca // 9.33.24 //
html:

slp1: kfkalAso Bavetso'pi BArate saptajanmasu tato BavenmahArOdro daridro'lpAyureva ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pumāṃsaṃ kāminī vāpi kāminīṃ vā pumānatha / yaḥ śukraṃ pāyayatyeva śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.25 //
html:
pumāṃsaṃ kāminī vāpi kāminīṃ vā pumānatha
yaḥ śukraṃ pāyayatyeva śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.25 //
slp1: pumAMsaM kAminI vApi kAminIM vA pumAnaTa yaH SukraM pAyayatyeva SukrakuRqaM prayAti saH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / kṛmiyoniṃ śatābdaṃ ca vrajedbhūtvā tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.26 //
html:
pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
kṛmiyoniṃ śatābdaṃ ca vrajedbhūtvā tataḥ śuciḥ // 9.33.26 //
slp1: pUrRamabdaSataM cEva tadBojI tatra tizWati kfmiyoniM SatAbdaM ca vrajedBUtvA tataH SuciH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: santāḍya ca guruṃ vipraṃ raktapātaṃ ca kārayet / sa ca tiṣṭhatyasṛkkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram // 9.33.27 //
html:
santāḍya ca guruṃ vipraṃ raktapātaṃ ca kārayet

slp1: santAqya ca guruM vipraM raktapAtaM ca kArayet sa ca tizWatyasfkkuRqe tadBojI Satavatsaram
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato labhedvyāghrajanma saptajanmasu bhārate / tataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti mānavaśca krameṇa ha // 9.33.28 //
html:

text: yo'śru tatyāja gāyantaṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā sagadgadam / śrīkṛṣṇaguṇasaṇgīte hasatyeva hi yo naraḥ // 9.33.29 //

author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tataḥ sa gārdabhīṃ yonimavāpnoti trijanmani / trijanmani ca śārgālīṃ tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhruvam // 9.33.32 //

slp1: tataH sa gArdaBIM yonimavApnoti trijanmani trijanmani ca SArgAlIM tataH SudDo Baved Druvam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato bhavetsa badhiro daridraḥ saptajanmasu / saptajanmanyaṇgahīnastataḥ śuddhiṃ labhed dhruvam // 9.33.34 //

text: lobhātsvabharaṇārthāya jīvinaṃ hanti yo naraḥ / majjākuṇḍe vasetso'pi tadbhojī lakṣavatsaram // 9.33.35 //

html:

html:
arthalobhānmahāmūḍho māṃsakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ

text: pratapte tāmrakuṇḍe ca śatavarṣaṃ sa tiṣṭhati / avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṇkte ṛtusnātānnameva ca // 9.33.49 //
html:

html:

slp1: sa ca taptasurAkuRqe SatAbdaM tizWati dvijaH tato BavecCUdrayAjI brAhmaRaH saptajanmasu
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddha ruvam / vāgduṣṭaḥ kaṭuko vācā tāḍayetsvāminaṃ sadā // 9.33.54 //
html:
śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddha ruvam
vāgduṣṭaḥ kaṭuko vācā tāḍayetsvāminaṃ sadā // 9.33.54 //
slp1: SUdraSrAdDAnnaBojI ca tataH SudDo BavedDa ruvam vAgduzwaH kawuko vAcA tAqayetsvAminaM sadA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍe sa tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / tāḍito yamadūtena daṇḍena ca caturguṇam // 9.33.55 //
html:
tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍe sa tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
tāḍito yamadūtena daṇḍena ca caturguṇam // 9.33.55 //
slp1: tIkzRakaRwakakuRqe sa tadBojI tatra tizWati tAqito yamadUtena daRqena ca caturguRam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tataḥ uccaiḥśravāḥ saptajanmasveva tataḥ śuci / viṣeṇa jīvanaṃ hanti nirdayo yo hi mānavaḥ // 9.33.56 //
html:
tataḥ uccaiḥśravāḥ saptajanmasveva tataḥ śuci
viṣeṇa jīvanaṃ hanti nirdayo yo hi mānavaḥ // 9.33.56 //
slp1: tataH uccEHSravAH saptajanmasveva tataH Suci vizeRa jIvanaM hanti nirdayo yo hi mAnavaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: viṣakuṇḍe ca tadbhojī sahasrābdaṃ ca tiṣṭhati / tato bhavennṛghātī ca vraṇī ca śatajanmasu // 9.33.57 //
html:
viṣakuṇḍe ca tadbhojī sahasrābdaṃ ca tiṣṭhati
tato bhavennṛghātī ca vraṇī ca śatajanmasu // 9.33.57 //
slp1: vizakuRqe ca tadBojI sahasrAbdaM ca tizWati tato BavennfGAtI ca vraRI ca Satajanmasu
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhuvam / daṇḍena tāḍayed gāṃ hi vṛṣanca vṛṣavāhakaḥ // 9.33.58 //
html:
saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhuvam
daṇḍena tāḍayed gāṃ hi vṛṣanca vṛṣavāhakaḥ // 9.33.58 //
slp1: saptajanmasu kuzWI ca tataH SudDo Baved Duvam daRqena tAqayed gAM hi vfzanca vfzavAhakaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: bhṛtyadvārā svatantro vā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate / pratapte tailakuṇḍe'gnau tiṣṭhati sma caturyugam // 9.33.59 //
html:
bhṛtyadvārā svatantro vā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate
pratapte tailakuṇḍe'gnau tiṣṭhati sma caturyugam // 9.33.59 //
slp1: BftyadvArA svatantro vA puRyakzetre ca BArate pratapte tElakuRqe'gnO tizWati sma caturyugam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati tatparam / kuntena hanti yo jīvaṃ vahnilohena helayā // 9.33.60 //
html:
gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati tatparam
kuntena hanti yo jīvaṃ vahnilohena helayā // 9.33.60 //
slp1: gavAM lomapramARAbdaM vfzo Bavati tatparam kuntena hanti yo jIvaM vahnilohena helayA
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kuntakuṇḍe vasetso'pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati / tataḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya codare vyādhisaṃyutaḥ // 9.33.61 //
html:
kuntakuṇḍe vasetso'pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati
tataḥ suyoniṃ samprāpya codare vyādhisaṃyutaḥ // 9.33.61 //
slp1: kuntakuRqe vasetso'pi varzARAmayutaM sati tataH suyoniM samprApya codare vyADisaMyutaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: janmanaikena kleśena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ / yo bhuṇkte ca vṛthā māṃsaṃ māṃsalobhī dvijādhamaḥ // 9.33.62 //
html:
janmanaikena kleśena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ
yo bhuṇkte ca vṛthā māṃsaṃ māṃsalobhī dvijādhamaḥ // 9.33.62 //
slp1: janmanEkena kleSena tataH SudDo BavennaraH yo BuRkte ca vfTA mAMsaM mAMsaloBI dvijADamaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: hareranaivedyabhojī kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ / svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati // 9.33.63 //
html:
hareranaivedyabhojī kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ
svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati // 9.33.63 //
slp1: hareranEvedyaBojI kfmikuRqaM prayAti saH svalomamAnavarzaM ca tadBojI tatra tizWati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato bhavenmlecchajātistrijanmani tato dvijaḥ / brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājī ca śūdraśrāddhānnabhojakaḥ // 9.33.64 //
html:
tato bhavenmlecchajātistrijanmani tato dvijaḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājī ca śūdraśrāddhānnabhojakaḥ // 9.33.64 //
slp1: tato BavenmlecCajAtistrijanmani tato dvijaH brAhmaRaH SUdrayAjI ca SUdraSrAdDAnnaBojakaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca pūyakuṇḍe vased dhruvam / yāvallomapramāṇābdaṃ yamadaṇḍena suvrate // 9.33.65 //
html:
śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca pūyakuṇḍe vased dhruvam
yāvallomapramāṇābdaṃ yamadaṇḍena suvrate // 9.33.65 //
slp1: SUdrARAM SavadAhI ca pUyakuRqe vased Druvam yAvallomapramARAbdaM yamadaRqena suvrate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati / tato bhāratamāgatya sa śūdraḥ saptajanmasu // 9.33.66 //
html:
tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati
tato bhāratamāgatya sa śūdraḥ saptajanmasu // 9.33.66 //
slp1: tAqito yamadUtena tadBojI tatra tizWati tato BAratamAgatya sa SUdraH saptajanmasu
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: mahārogī daridraśca badhiro mūka eva ca / kṛṣṇaṃ padmaṃ ca ke yasya taṃ sarpaṃ hanti yo naraḥ // 9.33.67 //
html:
mahārogī daridraśca badhiro mūka eva ca
kṛṣṇaṃ padmaṃ ca ke yasya taṃ sarpaṃ hanti yo naraḥ // 9.33.67 //
slp1: mahArogI daridraSca baDiro mUka eva ca kfzRaM padmaM ca ke yasya taM sarpaM hanti yo naraH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca sarpakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ / sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ so'tha yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ // 9.33.68 //
html:
svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca sarpakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ
sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ so'tha yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ // 9.33.68 //
slp1: svalomamAnavarzaM ca sarpakuRqaM prayAti saH sarpeRa BakzitaH so'Ta yamadUtena tAqitaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: vasecca sarpaviḍbhojī tataḥ sarpo bhaved dhruvam / tato bhavenmānavaśca svalpāyurdadrusaṃyutaḥ // 9.33.69 //
html:
vasecca sarpaviḍbhojī tataḥ sarpo bhaved dhruvam
tato bhavenmānavaśca svalpāyurdadrusaṃyutaḥ // 9.33.69 //
slp1: vasecca sarpaviqBojI tataH sarpo Baved Druvam tato BavenmAnavaSca svalpAyurdadrusaMyutaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: mahākleśena tanmṛtyuḥ sarpeṇa bhakṣitād dhruvam / vidhipradattajīvyāṃśca kṣudrajantūṃśca hanti yaḥ // 9.33.70 //
html:
mahākleśena tanmṛtyuḥ sarpeṇa bhakṣitād dhruvam
vidhipradattajīvyāṃśca kṣudrajantūṃśca hanti yaḥ // 9.33.70 //
slp1: mahAkleSena tanmftyuH sarpeRa BakzitAd Druvam viDipradattajIvyAMSca kzudrajantUMSca hanti yaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sa daṃśamaśayoḥ kuṇḍe jantumānābdameva ca / divāniśaṃ bhakṣitastairanāhāraśca śabdavān // 9.33.71 //
html:
sa daṃśamaśayoḥ kuṇḍe jantumānābdameva ca
divāniśaṃ bhakṣitastairanāhāraśca śabdavān // 9.33.71 //
slp1: sa daMSamaSayoH kuRqe jantumAnAbdameva ca divAniSaM BakzitastEranAhAraSca SabdavAn
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: hastapādādibaddhaśca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ / tato bhavetkṣudrajanturjātiśca yāvanī bhavet // 9.33.72 //
html:
hastapādādibaddhaśca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ
tato bhavetkṣudrajanturjātiśca yāvanī bhavet // 9.33.72 //
slp1: hastapAdAdibadDaSca yamadUtena tAqitaH tato BavetkzudrajanturjAtiSca yAvanI Bavet
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato bhavenmānavaśca so'ṇgahīnastataḥ śuciḥ / yo mūḍho madhumaśnāti hatvā ca madhumakṣikāḥ // 9.33.73 //
html:
tato bhavenmānavaśca so'ṇgahīnastataḥ śuciḥ
yo mūḍho madhumaśnāti hatvā ca madhumakṣikāḥ // 9.33.73 //
slp1: tato BavenmAnavaSca so'RgahInastataH SuciH yo mUQo maDumaSnAti hatvA ca maDumakzikAH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sa eva gārale kuṇḍe jīvamānābdakaṃ vaset / bhakṣito garalairdagdho yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ // 9.33.74 //
html:
sa eva gārale kuṇḍe jīvamānābdakaṃ vaset
bhakṣito garalairdagdho yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ // 9.33.74 //
slp1: sa eva gArale kuRqe jIvamAnAbdakaM vaset Bakzito garalErdagDo yamadUtena tAqitaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato hi makṣikājātistataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ / daṇḍaṃ karotyadaṇḍye ca vipre daṇḍaṃ karoti ca // 9.33.75 //
html:
tato hi makṣikājātistataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ
daṇḍaṃ karotyadaṇḍye ca vipre daṇḍaṃ karoti ca // 9.33.75 //
slp1: tato hi makzikAjAtistataH SudDo BavennaraH daRqaM karotyadaRqye ca vipre daRqaM karoti ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sa kuṇḍaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ kīṭānāṃ yāti satvaram / sa tallomapramāṇābdaṃ tatra tiṣṭhatyaharniśam // 9.33.76 //
html:
sa kuṇḍaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ kīṭānāṃ yāti satvaram
sa tallomapramāṇābdaṃ tatra tiṣṭhatyaharniśam // 9.33.76 //
slp1: sa kuRqaM vajradaMzwrARAM kIwAnAM yAti satvaram sa tallomapramARAbdaM tatra tizWatyaharniSam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śabdakṛdbhakṣitastaistu yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ / karoti rodanaṃ bhadre hāhākāraṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe // 9.33.77 //
html:
śabdakṛdbhakṣitastaistu yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ
karoti rodanaṃ bhadre hāhākāraṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe // 9.33.77 //
slp1: SabdakfdBakzitastEstu yamadUtena tAqitaH karoti rodanaM Badre hAhAkAraM kzaRe kzaRe
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: punaḥ sūkarayonau ca jāyate saptajanmasu / trijanmani kākayonau tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ // 9.33.78 //
html:
punaḥ sūkarayonau ca jāyate saptajanmasu
trijanmani kākayonau tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ // 9.33.78 //
slp1: punaH sUkarayonO ca jAyate saptajanmasu trijanmani kAkayonO tataH SudDo BavennaraH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: arthalobhena yo mūḍhaḥ prajādaṇḍaṃ karoti saḥ / vṛścikānāṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ ca tallomābdaṃ vased dhruvam // 9.33.79 //
html:
arthalobhena yo mūḍhaḥ prajādaṇḍaṃ karoti saḥ
vṛścikānāṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ ca tallomābdaṃ vased dhruvam // 9.33.79 //
slp1: arTaloBena yo mUQaH prajAdaRqaM karoti saH vfScikAnAM ca kuRqaM ca tallomAbdaM vased Druvam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato vṛścikajātiśca saptajanmasu bhārate / tato naraścāṇgahīno vyādhiśuddho bhaved dhruvam // 9.33.80 //
html:
tato vṛścikajātiśca saptajanmasu bhārate
tato naraścāṇgahīno vyādhiśuddho bhaved dhruvam // 9.33.80 //
slp1: tato vfScikajAtiSca saptajanmasu BArate tato naraScARgahIno vyADiSudDo Baved Druvam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: brāhmaṇaḥ śastradhārī yo hyanyeṣāṃ dhāvako bhavet / sandhyāhīnaśca yo vipro haribhaktivihīnakaḥ // 9.33.81 //
html:
brāhmaṇaḥ śastradhārī yo hyanyeṣāṃ dhāvako bhavet
sandhyāhīnaśca yo vipro haribhaktivihīnakaḥ // 9.33.81 //
slp1: brAhmaRaH SastraDArI yo hyanyezAM DAvako Bavet sanDyAhInaSca yo vipro hariBaktivihInakaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sa tiṣṭhati svalomābdaṃ kuṇḍeṣu ca śarādiṣu / viddhaḥ śarādibhiḥ śaśvattataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ // 9.33.82 //
html:
sa tiṣṭhati svalomābdaṃ kuṇḍeṣu ca śarādiṣu
viddhaḥ śarādibhiḥ śaśvattataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ // 9.33.82 //
slp1: sa tizWati svalomAbdaM kuRqezu ca SarAdizu vidDaH SarAdiBiH SaSvattataH SudDo BavennaraH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kārāgāre sāndhakāre praṇihanti prajāśca yaḥ / pramattaḥ svasya doṣeṇa golakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.83 //
html:
kārāgāre sāndhakāre praṇihanti prajāśca yaḥ
pramattaḥ svasya doṣeṇa golakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.83 //
slp1: kArAgAre sAnDakAre praRihanti prajASca yaH pramattaH svasya dozeRa golakuRqaM prayAti saH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sa paṇkataptatoyāktaṃ sāndhakāraṃ bhayaṇkaram / tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca kīṭaiśca saṃyuktaṃ golakuṇḍakam // 9.33.84 //
html:
sa paṇkataptatoyāktaṃ sāndhakāraṃ bhayaṇkaram
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca kīṭaiśca saṃyuktaṃ golakuṇḍakam // 9.33.84 //
slp1: sa paRkataptatoyAktaM sAnDakAraM BayaRkaram tIkzRadaMzwrESca kIwESca saMyuktaM golakuRqakam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kīṭairviddho vasettatra prajālomābdameva ca / tato bhavetprajābhṛtyastataḥ śuddho bhavetkramāt // 9.33.85 //
html:
kīṭairviddho vasettatra prajālomābdameva ca
tato bhavetprajābhṛtyastataḥ śuddho bhavetkramāt // 9.33.85 //
slp1: kIwErvidDo vasettatra prajAlomAbdameva ca tato BavetprajABftyastataH SudDo BavetkramAt
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sarovarādutthitāṃśca nakrādīnhanti yo naraḥ / nakrakaṇṭakamānābdaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.86 //
html:
sarovarādutthitāṃśca nakrādīnhanti yo naraḥ

slp1: sarovarAdutTitAMSca nakrAdInhanti yo naraH nakrakaRwakamAnAbdaM nakrakuRqaM prayAti saH

text: tato nakrādijātīyo bhavennakrādiṣu dhruvam / tataḥ sadyo viśuddho hi daṇḍenaiva punaḥ punaḥ // 9.33.87 //
html:
tato nakrādijātīyo bhavennakrādiṣu dhruvam
tataḥ sadyo viśuddho hi daṇḍenaiva punaḥ punaḥ // 9.33.87 //
slp1: tato nakrAdijAtIyo BavennakrAdizu Druvam tataH sadyo viSudDo hi daRqenEva punaH punaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: vakṣaḥ śroṇīstanāsyanca yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ / kāmena kāmuko yo hi puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate // 9.33.88 //
html:
vakṣaḥ śroṇīstanāsyanca yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ
kāmena kāmuko yo hi puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate // 9.33.88 //
slp1: vakzaH SroRIstanAsyanca yaH paSyati parastriyAH kAmena kAmuko yo hi puRyakzetre ca BArate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sa vasetkākakuṇḍe ca kākaiḥ sancūrṇalocanaḥ / tataḥ svalomamānābdaṃ bhaveddagdhastrijanmani // 9.33.89 //
html:
sa vasetkākakuṇḍe ca kākaiḥ sancūrṇalocanaḥ
tataḥ svalomamānābdaṃ bhaveddagdhastrijanmani // 9.33.89 //
slp1: sa vasetkAkakuRqe ca kAkEH sancUrRalocanaH tataH svalomamAnAbdaM BaveddagDastrijanmani
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: svarṇasteyī ca yo mūḍho bhārate suraviprayoḥ / sa ca manthānakuṇḍe vai svalomābdaṃ vased dhruvam // 9.33.90 //
html:
svarṇasteyī ca yo mūḍho bhārate suraviprayoḥ
sa ca manthānakuṇḍe vai svalomābdaṃ vased dhruvam // 9.33.90 //
slp1: svarRasteyI ca yo mUQo BArate suraviprayoH sa ca manTAnakuRqe vE svalomAbdaM vased Druvam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tāḍito yamadūtena manthānaiśchannalocanaḥ / tadviḍbhojī ca tatraiva tataścāndhastrijanmani // 9.33.91 //
html:
tāḍito yamadūtena manthānaiśchannalocanaḥ
tadviḍbhojī ca tatraiva tataścāndhastrijanmani // 9.33.91 //
slp1: tAqito yamadUtena manTAnESCannalocanaH tadviqBojI ca tatrEva tataScAnDastrijanmani
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: saptajanma daridraśca mahākrūraśca pātakī / bhārate svarṇakāraśca sa ca svarṇavaṇik tataḥ // 9.33.92 //
html:
saptajanma daridraśca mahākrūraśca pātakī
bhārate svarṇakāraśca sa ca svarṇavaṇik tataḥ // 9.33.92 //
slp1: saptajanma daridraSca mahAkrUraSca pAtakI BArate svarRakAraSca sa ca svarRavaRik tataH

text: yo bhārate tāmracauro lohacauraśca sundari / sa ca svalomamānābdaṃ bījakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ // 9.33.93 //
html:

text: tatraiva bījaviḍbhojī bījaiśca channalocanaḥ / tāḍito yamadūtena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ // 9.33.94 //
html:
tatraiva bījaviḍbhojī bījaiśca channalocanaḥ

html:

text: pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ sarvaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca vartulam / nimnaṃ pāṣāṇabhedaiśca pācitaṃ bahubhiḥ sati // 9.37.1 //
html:

nimnaṃ pāṣāṇabhedaiśca pācitaṃ bahubhiḥ sati // 9.37.1 //

text: na naśvaraṃ cāpralayaṃ nirmitaṃ ceśvarecchayā / kleśadaṃ pātakānāṃ ca nānārūpaṃ tadālayam // 9.37.2 //

author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: jvaladaṇgārarūpaṃ ca śatahastaśikhānvitam / paritaḥ krośamānaṃ ca vahnikuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam // 9.37.3 //
html:
jvaladaṇgārarūpaṃ ca śatahastaśikhānvitam

text: mahāśabdaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ paripūritam / rakṣitaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiścāpi santatam // 9.37.4 //
html:
mahāśabdaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ paripūritam

text: prataptodakapūrṇaṃ ca hiṃsrajantusamanvitam / mahāghoraṃ kākuśabdaṃ prahāreṇa dṛḍhena ca // 9.37.5 //

prataptodakapūrṇaṃ ca hiṃsrajantusamanvitam

text: krośārdhamānaṃ taddūtaistāḍitairmama pārṣadaiḥ / taptakṣārodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ punaḥ kākaiśca saṇkulam // 9.37.6 //
html:

text: saṇkulaṃ pāpibhiścaiva krośamānaṃ bhayānakam / trāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ // 9.37.7 //

saṇkulaṃ pāpibhiścaiva krośamānaṃ bhayānakam

text: pracaladbhiranāhāraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaiḥ / viḍbhireva kṛtaṃ pūrṇaṃ krośamānaṃ ca kutsitam // 9.37.8 //
html:
pracaladbhiranāhāraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaiḥ
viḍbhireva kṛtaṃ pūrṇaṃ krośamānaṃ ca kutsitam // 9.37.8 //
slp1: pracaladBiranAhArEH SuzkakaRWozWatAlukEH viqBireva kftaM pUrRaM kroSamAnaM ca kutsitam

text: atidurgandhisaṃsaktaṃ vyāptaṃ pāpibhiranvaham / tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca tadāhāraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ // 9.37.9 //
html:
atidurgandhisaṃsaktaṃ vyāptaṃ pāpibhiranvaham

text: rakṣeti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistatkīṭaireva bhakṣitaiḥ / taptamūtradravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ mūtrakīṭaiśca saṇkulam // 9.37.10 //

taptamūtradravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ mūtrakīṭaiśca saṇkulam // 9.37.10 //

text: yuktaṃ mahāpātakibhistatkīṭairbhakṣitaiḥ sadā / gavyūtimānaṃ dhvāntāktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam // 9.37.11 //

html:

text: tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca veṣṭitaṃ veṣṭitaiḥ sadā / krośārdhaṃ garakuṇḍaṃ ca garabhojibhiranvitam // 9.37.13 //

text: sarpākārervajradaṃṣṭrai śuṣkakaṇṭhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ / netrayormalapūrṇaṃ ca krośārdhaṃ kīṭasaṃyutam // 9.37.15 //

text: tadbhojibhiḥ pātakibhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ / śukrakuṇḍaṃ krośamitaṃ śukrakīṭaiśca saṃyutam // 9.37.17 //
html:
tadbhojibhiḥ pātakibhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ

text: tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca saṇkulaṃ kīṭabhakṣitam / pūrṇaṃ netrāśrubhistaptaṃ bahupāpibhiranvitam // 9.37.19 //

text: vāpīturyapramāṇaṃ ca rudadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ / nṛṇāṃ gātramalairyuktaṃ tadbhakṣaiḥ pāpibhiryutam // 9.37.20 //

text: dhanuḥśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ tannāgairveṣṭitaṃ bhavet / ṣaḍaśīti ca kuṇḍāni mayoktāni niśāmaya / lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi // 9.37.118 //
html:
dhanuḥśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ tannāgairveṣṭitaṃ bhavet
ṣaḍaśīti ca kuṇḍāni mayoktāni niśāmaya
lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi // 9.37.118 //
slp1: DanuHSataM nAgapUrRaM tannAgErvezwitaM Bavet zaqaSIti ca kuRqAni mayoktAni niSAmaya lakzaRaM cApi tezAM ca kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: devībhaktiṃ dehi mahyaṃ sārāṇāṃ caiva sārakam / puṃsāṃ muktidvārabījaṃ narakārṇavatārakam // 9.38.1 //
html:
devībhaktiṃ dehi mahyaṃ sārāṇāṃ caiva sārakam
puṃsāṃ muktidvārabījaṃ narakārṇavatārakam // 9.38.1 //
slp1: devIBaktiM dehi mahyaM sArARAM cEva sArakam puMsAM muktidvArabIjaM narakArRavatArakam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: kāraṇaṃ muktisārāṇāṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam / dārakaṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ kṛtapāpaughahāraṇam // 9.38.2 //
html:
kāraṇaṃ muktisārāṇāṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam
dārakaṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ kṛtapāpaughahāraṇam // 9.38.2 //
slp1: kAraRaM muktisArARAM sarvASuBavinASanam dArakaM karmavfkzARAM kftapApOGahAraRam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: muktiśca katithāpyasti kiṃ vā tāsāṃ ca lakṣaṇam / devībhaktiṃ bhaktibhedaṃ niṣekasyāpi khaṇḍanam // 9.38.3 //
html:
muktiśca katithāpyasti kiṃ vā tāsāṃ ca lakṣaṇam
devībhaktiṃ bhaktibhedaṃ niṣekasyāpi khaṇḍanam // 9.38.3 //
slp1: muktiSca katiTApyasti kiM vA tAsAM ca lakzaRam devIBaktiM BaktiBedaM nizekasyApi KaRqanam
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: tattvajnānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinirmitā / kinciṃjnānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara // 9.38.4 //
html:
tattvajnānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinirmitā
kinciṃjnānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara // 9.38.4 //
slp1: tattvajnAnavihInA ca strIjAtirviDinirmitA kinciMjnAnaM sAraBUtaM vada vedavidAM vara
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: sarvaṃ dānaṃ ca yajnaśca tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ / ajnānijnānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm // 9.38.5 //
html:
sarvaṃ dānaṃ ca yajnaśca tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ
ajnānijnānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm // 9.38.5 //
slp1: sarvaM dAnaM ca yajnaSca tIrTasnAnaM vrataM tapaH ajnAnijnAnadAnasya kalAM nArhanti zoqaSIm
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: pituḥ śataguṇā mātā gaurave ceti niścitam / mātuḥ śataguṇaḥ pūjyo jnānadātā guruḥ prabho // 9.38.6 //
html:
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā gaurave ceti niścitam
mātuḥ śataguṇaḥ pūjyo jnānadātā guruḥ prabho // 9.38.6 //
slp1: pituH SataguRA mAtA gOrave ceti niScitam mAtuH SataguRaH pUjyo jnAnadAtA guruH praBo
author: sāvitryuvāca

text: pūrvaṃ sarvo varo datto yaste manasi vānchitaḥ / adhunā śaktibhaktiste vatse bhavatu madvarāt // 9.38.7 //
html:
pūrvaṃ sarvo varo datto yaste manasi vānchitaḥ
adhunā śaktibhaktiste vatse bhavatu madvarāt // 9.38.7 //
slp1: pUrvaM sarvo varo datto yaste manasi vAnCitaH aDunA SaktiBaktiste vatse Bavatu madvarAt
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śrotumicchasi kalyāṇi śrīdevīguṇakīrtanam / vaktṝṇāṃ pṛcchakānāṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ kulatāraṇam // 9.38.8 //
html:
śrotumicchasi kalyāṇi śrīdevīguṇakīrtanam
vaktṝṇāṃ pṛcchakānāṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ kulatāraṇam // 9.38.8 //
slp1: SrotumicCasi kalyARi SrIdevIguRakIrtanam vaktFRAM pfcCakAnAM ca SrotFRAM kulatAraRam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: śeṣo vaktrasahasreṇa nahi yadvaktumīśvaraḥ / mṛtyunjayo na kṣamaśca vaktuṃ pancamukhena ca // 9.38.9 //
html:
śeṣo vaktrasahasreṇa nahi yadvaktumīśvaraḥ
mṛtyunjayo na kṣamaśca vaktuṃ pancamukhena ca // 9.38.9 //
slp1: Sezo vaktrasahasreRa nahi yadvaktumISvaraH mftyunjayo na kzamaSca vaktuM pancamuKena ca
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi / brahmā caturmukhenaiva nālaṃ viṣṇuśca sarvavit // 9.38.10 //
html:
dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi
brahmā caturmukhenaiva nālaṃ viṣṇuśca sarvavit // 9.38.10 //
slp1: DAtA caturRAM vedAnAM viDAtA jagatAmapi brahmA caturmuKenEva nAlaM vizRuSca sarvavit
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kārtikeyaḥ ṣaṇmukhena nāpi vaktumalaṃ dhruvam / na gaṇeśaḥ samarthaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ // 9.38.11 //
html:
kārtikeyaḥ ṣaṇmukhena nāpi vaktumalaṃ dhruvam
na gaṇeśaḥ samarthaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ // 9.38.11 //
slp1: kArtikeyaH zaRmuKena nApi vaktumalaM Druvam na gaReSaH samarTaSca yogIndrARAM gurorguruH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sārabhūtāśca śāstrāṇāṃ vedāścatvāra eva ca / kalāmātraṃ yadguṇānāṃ na vidanti budhāśca ye // 9.38.12 //
html:
sārabhūtāśca śāstrāṇāṃ vedāścatvāra eva ca
kalāmātraṃ yadguṇānāṃ na vidanti budhāśca ye // 9.38.12 //
slp1: sAraBUtASca SAstrARAM vedAScatvAra eva ca kalAmAtraM yadguRAnAM na vidanti buDASca ye
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā nālaṃ tadguṇavarṇane / sanatkumāro dharmaśca sanandanaḥ sanātanaḥ // 9.38.13 //
html:
sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā nālaṃ tadguṇavarṇane
sanatkumāro dharmaśca sanandanaḥ sanātanaḥ // 9.38.13 //
slp1: sarasvatI jaqIBUtA nAlaM tadguRavarRane sanatkumAro DarmaSca sanandanaH sanAtanaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sanakaḥ kapilaḥ sūryo ye'nye ca brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ / vicakṣaṇā na yadvaktuṃ kincānye jaḍabuddhayaḥ // 9.38.14 //
html:
sanakaḥ kapilaḥ sūryo ye'nye ca brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
vicakṣaṇā na yadvaktuṃ kincānye jaḍabuddhayaḥ // 9.38.14 //
slp1: sanakaH kapilaH sUryo ye'nye ca brahmaRaH sutAH vicakzaRA na yadvaktuM kincAnye jaqabudDayaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: na yadvaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā / ke cānye ca vayaṃ ke vā śrīdevyā guṇavarṇane // 9.38.15 //
html:
na yadvaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā
ke cānye ca vayaṃ ke vā śrīdevyā guṇavarṇane // 9.38.15 //
slp1: na yadvaktuM kzamAH sidDA munIndrA yoginastaTA ke cAnye ca vayaM ke vA SrIdevyA guRavarRane
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ / atisādhyaṃ svabhaktānāṃ tadanyeṣāṃ sudurlabham // 9.38.16 //
html:
dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ
atisādhyaṃ svabhaktānāṃ tadanyeṣāṃ sudurlabham // 9.38.16 //
slp1: DyAyante yatpadAmBojaM brahmavizRuSivAdayaH atisADyaM svaBaktAnAM tadanyezAM sudurlaBam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: kaścitkincidvijānāti tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ śubham / atiriktaṃ vijānāti brahmā brahmaviśāradaḥ // 9.38.17 //
html:
kaścitkincidvijānāti tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ śubham
atiriktaṃ vijānāti brahmā brahmaviśāradaḥ // 9.38.17 //
slp1: kaScitkincidvijAnAti tadguRotkIrtanaM SuBam atiriktaM vijAnAti brahmA brahmaviSAradaH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tato'tiriktaṃ jānāti gaṇeśo jnānināṃ guruḥ / sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajnaḥ śambhureva saḥ // 9.38.18 //
html:
tato'tiriktaṃ jānāti gaṇeśo jnānināṃ guruḥ
sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajnaḥ śambhureva saḥ // 9.38.18 //
slp1: tato'tiriktaM jAnAti gaReSo jnAninAM guruH sarvAtiriktaM jAnAti sarvajnaH SamBureva saH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tasmai dattaṃ purā jnānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā / atīva nirjane'raṇye goloke rāsamaṇḍale // 9.38.19 //
html:
tasmai dattaṃ purā jnānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā
atīva nirjane'raṇye goloke rāsamaṇḍale // 9.38.19 //
slp1: tasmE dattaM purA jnAnaM kfzRena paramAtmanA atIva nirjane'raRye goloke rAsamaRqale
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tatraiva kathitaṃ kincittadguṇotkīrtanaṃ śubham / dharmaṃ ca kathayāmāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam // 9.38.20 //
html:
tatraiva kathitaṃ kincittadguṇotkīrtanaṃ śubham
dharmaṃ ca kathayāmāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam // 9.38.20 //
slp1: tatrEva kaTitaM kincittadguRotkIrtanaM SuBam DarmaM ca kaTayAmAsa Sivaloke SivaH svayam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: dharmastu kathayāmāsa bhāsvate pṛcchate tathā / yāmārādhya matpitāpi samprāpa tapasā sati // 9.38.21 //
html:

yāmārādhya matpitāpi samprāpa tapasā sati // 9.38.21 //
slp1: Darmastu kaTayAmAsa BAsvate pfcCate taTA yAmArADya matpitApi samprApa tapasA sati
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: pūrvaṃ svaṃ viṣayaṃ cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prayatnataḥ / vairāgyayuktastapase gantumicchāmi suvrate // 9.38.22 //
html:
pūrvaṃ svaṃ viṣayaṃ cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prayatnataḥ
vairāgyayuktastapase gantumicchāmi suvrate // 9.38.22 //
slp1: pUrvaM svaM vizayaM cAhaM na gfhRAmi prayatnataH vErAgyayuktastapase gantumicCAmi suvrate
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tadā māṃ kathayāmāsa pitā tadguṇakīrtanam / yathāgamaṃ tadvadāmi nibodhātīva durgamam // 9.38.23 //
html:
tadā māṃ kathayāmāsa pitā tadguṇakīrtanam
yathāgamaṃ tadvadāmi nibodhātīva durgamam // 9.38.23 //
slp1: tadA mAM kaTayAmAsa pitA tadguRakIrtanam yaTAgamaM tadvadAmi niboDAtIva durgamam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: tadguṇaṃ sā na jānāti tadanyasya ca kā kathā / yathākāśo na jānāti svāntameva varānane // 9.38.24 //
html:
tadguṇaṃ sā na jānāti tadanyasya ca kā kathā
yathākāśo na jānāti svāntameva varānane // 9.38.24 //
slp1: tadguRaM sA na jAnAti tadanyasya ca kA kaTA yaTAkASo na jAnAti svAntameva varAnane
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: sarvātmā sarvabhagavān sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ / sarveśvaraśca sarvādyaḥ sarvavitparipālakaḥ | 25 / nityarūpī nityadehī nityānando nirākṛtiḥ / niraṇkuśo nirāśaṇko nirguṇaśca nirāmayaḥ // 9.38.26 //
html:

sarveśvaraśca sarvādyaḥ sarvavitparipālakaḥ | 25
nityarūpī nityadehī nityānando nirākṛtiḥ

slp1: sarvAtmA sarvaBagavAn sarvakAraRakAraRaH sarveSvaraSca sarvAdyaH sarvavitparipAlakaH . 25 nityarUpI nityadehI nityAnando nirAkftiH niraRkuSo nirASaRko nirguRaSca nirAmayaH

text: nirliptaḥ sarvasākṣī ca sarvādhāraḥ parātparaḥ / māyāviśiṣṭaḥ prakṛtistadvikārāśca prākṛtāḥ // 9.38.27 //

slp1: nirliptaH sarvasAkzI ca sarvADAraH parAtparaH mAyAviSizwaH prakftistadvikArASca prAkftAH
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: svayaṃ pumāṃśca prakṛtistāvabhinnau parasparam / yathā vahnestasya śaktirna bhinnāstyeva kutracit // 9.38.28 //
html:

slp1: svayaM pumAMSca prakftistAvaBinnO parasparam yaTA vahnestasya Saktirna BinnAstyeva kutracit

text: seyaṃ śaktirmahāmāyā saccidānandarūpiṇī / rūpaṃ bibhartyarūpā ca bhaktānugrahahetave // 9.38.29 //

seyaṃ śaktirmahāmāyā saccidānandarūpiṇī

slp1: seyaM SaktirmahAmAyA saccidAnandarUpiRI rUpaM biBartyarUpA ca BaktAnugrahahetave
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: gopālasundarīrūpaṃ prathamaṃ sā sasarja ha / atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ sumanoharam // 9.38.30 //

slp1: gopAlasundarIrUpaM praTamaM sA sasarja ha atIva kamanIyaM ca sundaraM sumanoharam
author: dharmarāja uvāca

text: navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam / kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam // 9.38.31 //

kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam // 9.38.31 //

html:

slp1: amUlyaratnanirmARanAnABUzaRaBUzitam sasmitaM SoBitaM SaSvadamUlyapItavAsasA

html:

text: gopībhirvīkṣyamāṇaṃ ca sasmitābhiśca santatam / rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam // 9.38.35 //

text: vaṃśīṃ kvaṇantaṃ dvibhujaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam / kaustubhendramaṇīndreṇa śaśvadvakṣaḥsthalojjvalam // 9.38.36 //

slp1: vaMSIM kvaRantaM dviBujaM vanamAlAviBUzitam kOstuBendramaRIndreRa SaSvadvakzaHsTalojjvalam

text: cārucandrakaśobhāḍhyaṃ cūḍāvaṇkrimarājitam / evambhūtaṃ ca dhyāyanti bhaktā bhaktipariplutāḥ // 9.38.38 //
html:
cārucandrakaśobhāḍhyaṃ cūḍāvaṇkrimarājitam

slp1: cArucandrakaSoBAQyaM cUqAvaRkrimarAjitam evamBUtaM ca DyAyanti BaktA BaktipariplutAH

html:

html:

text: yajjnānājjnānavānasti yogīśo jnānavitprabhuḥ / paramānandayuktaśca bhaktivairāgyasaṃyutaḥ // 9.38.42 //
